enchantments.tooltip: +1 Enhancement Bonus: +1 enhancement bonus to Armor Class, attack and damage rolls.
Darkwood: Darkwood is an unusually light and hardy type of wood. It is half the weight of normal wood, but +1 hardness. Armor check penalty reduced by 2.
Twilight: This suit of armor, favored by eladrin spellcasters, becomes semi-incorporeal when donned. The twilight armor reduces the chance of arcane spell failure by -10%.
